reasons.A: Short plain declaratives with list fragments and a dry, understated aside ('I probably should') that matches the passage's quiet wit and rule-stating close.
reasons.B: Very close in movement and plainness, but it stacks one-word fragments ('Stalks. Eggshells.') and clipped beats a little more thickly than the passage does.
reasons.D: Plain short sentences, but it summarises more ('a whole year of the house'), and its connective 'So... And...' ending reads more generic and less dry.
reasons.C: Long, balanced sentences with semicolons, colons and lyrical touches ('smells of woods rather than rubbish'); a fuller literary register far from the author's clipped plainness.
